basic_info.title: Grab-Posisi: An Extensive Real-Life GPS Trajectory Dataset in Southeast Asia

venue.name: SIGSPATIAL 2019, 3rd ACM SIGSPATIAL Workshop on Prediction of Human Mobility (PredictGIS)

method.input_representation: raw_GPS_fixes (1s sampling, accuracy metadata, driving mode)
method.notes: Large real-life ride-hailing GPS corpus from Singapore and Jakarta: high-frequency (~1s) fixes with accuracy level, bearing, speed, phone-OS and car/motorcycle mode metadata. Named in the capacity review (P4/data-diversity axis) as a candidate additional corpus for cross-city data scaling alongside on-disk Porto/T-Drive/Geolife. NOT currently in data/ — acquisition requires request to Grab.

gap_analysis.novelty_reasoning: Tracked as a data-scaling resource for the P1 data ablation extension and OOD generalization work.

relevance.bmw_relevance: Direct if multi-city generalization becomes a product commitment: dense SEA fleet GPS complements Porto (Europe) and T-Drive/Geolife (Beijing).

uncertain: Exact author list and current dataset availability/licensing not re-verified (2026-07-11); access historically gated by Grab request form.
